title: As Super Micro Computer Expands Its Data Center Offerings, Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold SMCI Stock?
title_zh: 随着 Super Micro Computer 扩展其数据中心产品，您应该购买、出售还是持有 SMCI 股票？
summary: With price targets implying moderate upside and the next earnings report likely to set the tone, investors consider the best way to move with SMCI?
summary_zh: 鉴于价格目标意味着温和的上涨空间，并且下一份收益报告可能会定下基调，投资者考虑跟随 SMCI 采取行动的最佳方式是什么？

title: Tech ETFs: XLK Offers Lower Fees While IYW Provides Broader Tech Exposure
title_zh: 科技 ETF：XLK 提供更低的费用，而 IYW 提供更广泛的科技投资

title: Morgan Stanley leads consumer M&A deal ranks in Q1
title_zh: 摩根士丹利第一季度消费者并购交易排名领先
summary: According to GlobalData figures, Morgan Stanley was the sector’s top M&A financial adviser by value and volume of deals.
summary_zh: 根据 GlobalData 的数据，按交易价值和交易量计算，摩根士丹利是该行业顶级的并购财务顾问。

title: BASF Coatings Launches $2 Billion Debt Sale To Fund Carlyle Acquisition
title_zh: 巴斯夫涂料公司启动 20 亿美元债务出售，为凯雷收购提供资金
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Banks have moved to launch a debt sale exceeding $2 billion tied to the carve-out of BASF SE's (BASFY) coatings division, a deal that could offer a timely read on investor appetite for chemicals exposure.
summary_zh: 本文首发于 GuruFocus。银行已着手启动一项超过 20 亿美元的债务出售，与剥离巴斯夫股份公司 (BASFY) 涂料部门相关，这项交易可以及时了解投资者对化学品敞口的兴趣。
